title: Hangar launch catapult
place: A cavernous underground hangar, a giant robot locked into a rail catapult, warning lights spinning, a tunnel ramp aimed at the city above
situation: The robot is clamped in and the countdown is running when someone notices a locking bolt still engaged; the launch fires anyway
visualTropes: sparks spraying off the launch rail
restraint arms snapping away one by one
the pilot pressed flat into the seat by g-force
a tunnel of rushing lights
jokeHooks: the launch checklist has one unchecked box labeled tests, and the catapult fires anyway
every restraint arm releases except the one held by a stale lock file
the robot exits the tunnel still dragging the staging gantry behind it

title: Five machines combine
place: Open sky above a canyon, five color-coded vehicles (a jet, a tank, a truck, a sub, a drill) flying into formation against sunset
situation: The team shouts the combine command and the vehicles leap together into one giant robot, but one piece clicks into the wrong socket
visualTropes: vehicles unfolding into limbs in midair
a rainbow energy beam binding the parts
five pilots in a split-screen cockpit shot
a final heroic pose with a cape of light
jokeHooks: five services deploy at once and the leg module is on an old version, so the robot walks in circles
the merge sequence succeeds but the head is installed facing backward
one pilot skipped the version bump and their vehicle docks as the left foot again

place: A neon downtown at night, skyscrapers knee-high to a giant robot and a scaly sea monster wrestling through intersections and overpasses

a rocket fist launched on a chain
falling billboards and sparking power lines
tiny cars thrown like toys
jokeHooks: fixing one bug makes the monster grow two more heads, each a new failing test
the attack name takes longer to shout than the build takes to run
the robot's punch hits the right monster only on the second retry

situation: Scientists watch the pilot's sync rate climb and dip as the robot outside twitches in response to every stray thought

a sync meter bouncing at 99 percent

warning text in huge red block letters
jokeHooks: sync stalls at 99 percent like test coverage that will not reach the threshold

the sync test only passes when nobody is watching, like a flaky test

auroras reflected in a cracked visor

ice shattering off a shoulder
jokeHooks: the ancient robot runs on a legacy codebase with comments in a dead language
